thread:
anna_peopleops: Heads-up — new exec assistant (L. Chen) starts Monday 9/12. Quick checklist: I-9 docs flagged (no SSN on file), background check still 'identity match issue', needs laptop shipped overnight, and day-1 orientation moved to 10am because of travel. Can folks help coordinate? :wave:
maya-recruiter: Thanks Anna. L. Chen emailed — passport + driver's license scanned but they used a maiden name on one doc. BGC flagged mismatch. I asked them to upload marriage certificate to the portal but not sure how fast that will be.
omar_talent: For I-9 remote verification, we can use an authorized agent vendor (notary) in their city. Are we ok to approve an exception to do a 3rd-party verification?
anna_peopleops: Yes, we have precedent. Need approval from People Ops lead — cc @omar_talent for sign-off. Also need to confirm remote I-9 agent cost (usually $75-125).
maya-recruiter: I called L. Chen — can do agent tomorrow morning if we book today. She prefers in-person courier pickup for docs rather than upload.
sam-engineering: On laptop: can we ship a macbook pre-imaged to home address overnight? We have one in staging but image includes secrets token that needs rotation. I can image and create temp user. ETA to ship if we sign-off today: 6–8 hours.
devex: I can handle account provisioning (Slack, GCP proj, RW console). Will need full name + preferred email + manager. Also need to know if they should be added to prod access on day 1 (recommend no).
anna_peopleops: Manager (Sara K) requests limited dev access on day 1, ramp to prod in week 2. Sara also requested benefits orientation slot at 2pm day 1. Can we fit that?
maya-recruiter: Confirmed Sara K. Benefits 2pm works. Orientation start 10am (people ops intro + IT).
bg-checks-bot: Background check status for L. Chen (order #BGC-83921): identity match failure. Pending supplemental docs from candidate. Expected update ETA 24–48h after upload.
omar_talent: Approving authorized agent for I-9 verification. Anna, please submit vendor request to legal for one-time payment.
anna_peopleops: Filed vendor request -> receipts@legal. Also created travel exception for orientation time in the calendar.
sam-engineering: I’ll image and request overnight courier. Need shipping address and signature name. Maya, can you confirm shipping details now so I can hand to logistics?
maya-recruiter: Shipping address sent via DM to Sam. Also DM'd candidate to ask for marriage cert upload as backup.
devex: Provisioning checklist started. Creating temp slack handle lchen-temp. Will not enable prod keys until week 2.
anna_peopleops: Awesome — can we reconvene in this thread when courier label done and I-9 agent confirmed? If BGC clears later today we’ll move orientation back to standard docs path; if not, we proceed with agent. :thumbsup:
maya-recruiter: Will update here after upload or courier booking.
bg-checks-bot: Candidate uploaded supplemental doc: marriage_certificate.pdf at 2003460305. Re-running identity match.
anna_peopleops: Thanks bot. Fingers crossed. If match fails, agent booked for 9:30am local tomorrow (pending payment).
omar_talent: Approved the payment. Please let me know final cost and vendor name for records.
anna_peopleops: Vendor: OnsiteVerify LLC. Paid via one-time PO. Courier label created, overnight FedEx tracking: 612345678901. Sam, you should have label in staging.
sam-engineering: Got label, dropping at FedEx now. ETA delivery tomorrow morning.
maya-recruiter: Candidate confirmed upload and also sent selfie with ID (per agent request). She’s relieved.
anna_peopleops: Closing loop — orientation schedule stands at 10am, benefits 2pm, laptop arriving overnight, I-9 agent on standby. Will post final confirmation once bg-checks-bot passes or agent completes. :white_check_mark:
